violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. The final hot water rinse temperature at the mechanical warewashing machine was below the required 160ºF. The unit was tested 5 times with temperatures of 144º, 146º, 150º, 156º, and 156º reached.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. The PIC will put in a work order to have the unit repaired and use the 3-vat sink to clean and sanitize all equipment and utensils until repaired. CDI

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the mechanical dishwashing machine was not working properly. Please have it repaired as soon as possible and notify you EHS when corrected.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. The establishment is using bleach for wet wiping cloths but does not have a test kit for it.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a bleach test kit as soon as possible or within 10 days. The PIC ordered a bleach test kit during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: There is a hose connected to the mop sink faucet. The hose extends into the mop sink, which is not permitted.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. Please cut the hose so that it hangs just above the flood level rim of the mop sink. The PIC removed the hose during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: Observed there are no air gaps or air breaks on the two compartment sink in the back part of the kitchen. These sinks are used for food preparation and must have air gaps or air breaks.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. The person in charge will contact their maintenance department to have airgaps installed, and will not use the sinks for food preparation until the air gaps are installed. Please contact your EHS when the air gaps are installed. This requires a reinspection.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 180F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 180F. OBSERVED TEMPERATURE AT APPROXIMATELY 150 DEGREES, DISHES ARE NOT BEING SANITIZED.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CFM SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR ALL DISHES TO BE SANITIZED IN SINK AFTER GOING THROUGH DISH MACHINE.
